title: Taung Child points to Africa as our cradle
summary: Raymond Dart described a small fossil skull from a South African lime quarry as Australopithecus africanus in Nature on 7 February 1925. It was among the first early human-relative fossils from Africa.
why: The first fossil evidence that humanity's roots lie in Africa.
superlativeSource: one of the first early hominin fossils to be found in Africa
